bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Filed by the bank as a '2nd quarter' discrete filing. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2020. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2021 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2021) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. SOURCE-DOCUMENT QUIRK: this filing's own P&L/Cash-Flow page headers misprint the year as 'for the period ended 30 June 2024' / 'July 13,2024' (a template typo), while every other page and the actual data columns ('30-Jun-21' / '31-Dec-20', 'July 13,2021' elsewhere in the same filing) confirm this is genuinely the quarter ended 30 June 2021. Source PDF is a scanned filing with a badly garbled main Profit & Loss table (columns visually overlapped in the scan); the headline figures below were instead sourced from this filing's own clean 'Selective Notes' section (NAV/share, EPS, NOCFPS, tax reconciliation), then the operating-income/expense breakdown was reconciled algebraically against those anchors (Total operating income (A) and Total operating expenses (B) were the two sub-totals legible in the main table; operating profit before provision (C) re-derived as A-B; provision (D) resolved as -30.0m, a net recovery, since only that sign closes C-D to the Notes-derived PBT of -211,502,841 exactly, which in turn equals the Notes' own net-profit-after-tax of -212,585,394 plus the Notes' own minimum-tax figure of 1,082,553). Balance sheet cross-validated: 31-Dec-2020 comparative (total assets 11,260.02m, equity -11,659.25m) matches 2020_Q4.json exactly.
